name: Rocket
address: 27 Arbour Rd, Heatherlands, George, 6529, South Africa
description_short: Artisan coffee roastery and bistro serving specialty brews and fresh seasonal food in Heatherlands.
description_long:
Rocket has carved out a reputation as George's go-to spot for serious coffee lovers and anyone after a proper meal in relaxed surroundings. The roastery supplies beans to cafes across the Garden Route, and you can taste why — each cup is carefully crafted, from espresso to pour-over. The bistro menu moves beyond standard cafe fare with seasonal dishes that change regularly, think hearty breakfast bowls, thoughtful sandwiches, and lunch plates that make the most of local ingredients.

The space itself feels unpretentious and welcoming, with indoor seating and a small courtyard that catches morning sun. It's the kind of place that works equally well for a quick flat white and pastry or a long Saturday brunch with friends. The vibe is laid-back George — good music, friendly service, and no fuss.

Located in Heatherlands, Rocket draws a mix of locals who've made it their regular and visitors who've heard about the coffee. Whether you're stocking up on beans from the retail section or settling in for breakfast, it's worth the visit for quality that doesn't try too hard.
